harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Connected lan-a (10.10.10.0/24) and lan-b (10.20.20.0/24) through routed WireGuard wg01 on both VyOS gateways. Node4 reaches node3’s persistent TCP/8080 application, source addresses remain untranslated, and other new cross-LAN connections are denied. All four nodes passed sequential restart-persistence checks.
actions_performed: Configured persistent LAN addressing and routes on all nodes.
Generated and installed gateway-local WireGuard keys and saved wg01 configuration.
Applied default-deny forwarding with an exception for node4 to node3 TCP/8080 and established/related traffic.
Enabled the persistent lan-a application service on node3.
Verified application access, source-address preservation, and denial of other cross-LAN traffic.
Restarted every node individually and verified changed boot identities and full recovery.

evidence.requirement: Routed WireGuard wg01 connects lan-a and lan-b
evidence.summary: Post-restart evidence shows wg01 addresses, remote-LAN routes, allowed prefixes, recent handshakes, and transferred traffic on both gateways.

evidence.requirement: Node3 serves the lan-a application on TCP/8080
evidence.summary: Shows node3’s recovered LAN address and route, enabled/active service, TCP/8080 listener, and persisted application data.

evidence.requirement: Node4 reaches the application through the tunnel
evidence.summary: Shows node4’s source address and route through its LAN gateway plus successful retrieval of “lan-a application” after all restarts.

evidence.requirement: Cross-LAN traffic is free of address translation
evidence.summary: Both gateways report NAT is not configured, while node3 logs the original node4 source address 10.20.20.10.

evidence.requirement: Only new node4-to-node3 TCP/8080 cross-LAN connections are allowed
evidence.summary: Saved default-drop policies allow only the specified application flow; TCP/8080 succeeds while TCP/22 times out despite a live node3 TCP/22 listener.
Healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, restored LAN/wg01 route and fresh handshake, followed by successful application access.
Healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, restored LAN/wg01 route and fresh handshake, followed by successful application access.
Healthy service/data baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, restored addressing, route, service, listener and data, plus remote application access.
Healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, restored LAN route, successful application access, and retained deny policy.
